description: Defines the SubformState class which manages the state of a subform within Drupal's form API, including parent form relationships, validation, and error handling.

classes.name: SubformState
classes.description: Manages the state of a subform, including parent relationships, validation errors, and form object retrieval within Drupal's form API.

methods.name: createForSubform
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SubformState instance for a specific subform.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Retrieves the parent form hierarchy relative to the subform, ensuring the subform is contained within the parent form.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the form values specific to the subform.

methods.name: getCompleteFormState
methods.description: Retrieves the complete form state, delegating if decorated.

methods.name: setLimitValidationErrors
methods.description: Sets validation errors with optional limits, considering subform hierarchy.

methods.name: getLimitValidationErrors
methods.description: Gets validation errors with respect to subform hierarchy.

methods.name: setErrorByName
methods.description: Sets an error message for a specific form element within the subform.

methods.name: getFormObject
methods.description: Returns the form object associated with the subform, if available.
